questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how BudgetPacer handles concurrent impression charges for the same campaign? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
A campaign has dailyBudgetMicros 1,000,000, bidMicros 300,000, and 900,000 already spent today. What does a single charge return?
How does spend reset at the start of a new day?
choices: A scheduled job deletes the spend keys at midnight
The key includes the UTC date, so a new day reads a fresh key that defaults to 0
The 48 hour TTL expires the previous value before the next day
It never resets; budgets are cumulative

questions.prompt: The day key is computed from this.now() in UTC. What is a consequence for an advertiser in UTC-8?
choices: Their budget resets at 4pm local time (midnight UTC)
Their budget resets at local midnight
Each impression uses a random day key
